description: What a single cross-border payment costs, in basis points, against an independent mid-market reference: give the amount sent, the amount that landed (or a provider says will land) and the date. Returns the Landed Drag Index with its margin of error and the evidence tier. Free, no key.

destinationCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code the payment lands in, e.g. 'EUR'.

inputAmount.description: Amount sent, in the source currency.

midSpot.description: Optional. Your own mid, destination units per source unit. Omit to use SwapEazi's reference.

netLandedFiat.description: Amount that landed or will land, in the destination currency, after every deduction.

settledOn.description: ISO date the payment settled. Omit it (or pass a future date) for a quote not yet accepted: it is measured against today's reference.

sourceCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code the payment is funded in, e.g. 'GBP'.

name: swapeazi_landed_cost
title: Landed cost of a payment
